fusions.name: Tangle the Pack
fusions.desc: Flings a mesh around you that deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 40% chance to turn each against its own side for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Empty the Snare
fusions.desc: Flicks a light mesh that robs the first enemy it meets of everything you have caught on it, dealing 18 damage and using up every affliction you have on that target for 60% more damage each.

fusions.name: Hunter's Blind
fusions.desc: Throws a screen of mesh over you and your allies, veiling you all for 6 seconds and making you 10% faster. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: No Clean Escape
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.
